title: A must do experience..!!
text:
An excellent experience even for someone who's never flown in a helicopter before. A very nice reception area and polite and helpful staff.
The Robinson Raven was the perfect aircraft for the tour. Very smooth and comfortable with reasonable legroom. Perfect viewing windows and plenty to see. Very competent pilot...
author: TheLonelyNomad
